dedupe_keys.name: interior gencat cat dams and flood defences datasets

description: interior.gencat.cat: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by interior.gencat.cat. Coverage: the area served by interior.gencat.cat. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zonas inundables de la presa de Rialb, hipótesis H2, rotura de presa e; Elementos vulnerables de la presa de Sau, hipótesis H2, rotura de pres; Elementos vulnerables de la presa de Rialb, hipótesis H2, rotura de pr; Elementos vulnerables presa de Boadella, hipótesis H2, rotura de presa. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://governobert.gencat.cat/ca/dades_obertes/llicencia-oberta-informacio-catalunya/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
